# Files whose type errors CI ignores (.github/scripts/typecheck.ts): each one also fails the type check in
# SpaceFleet's upstream repository, where this code is developed, so the error is not caused by the public
# export. One line per file: <file><TAB><what fails>; fails upstream too
# Every other file must type-check. A listed file that has no type error any more fails CI; the line goes.
apps/badger/jellyfin/sidecar/src/server.ts	passes a Buffer | null where the Response body type is expected; fails upstream too
